items.quote:
Gaal led out the citizens of Shechem and fought Abimelek.
40  Abimelek chased him all the way to the entrance of the gate
items.contrast: Gaal versus the citizens of Shechem as the referent of “him.”
items.reason: The citizens are a plausible alternative because Gaal led them into battle and many fled. However, the singular pronoun “him” refers to the singular antecedent Gaal, whereas the group is treated plurally later as “they.” The question and key clearly resolve this reference.
